title: Static friction magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly identifies that static friction equals the applied force (80 N) when the sofa is stationary.

title: Kinetic friction coefficient
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the coefficient of kinetic friction (0.4) using the force for constant velocity and the normal force.

title: Kinetic friction under new force
description: Essential: Correctly states that kinetic friction remains 120 N under a 140 N applied force, as it depends only on normal force and coefficient.

title: Force balance reasoning
description: Important: Applies Newton's first law correctly for both stationary and constant velocity scenarios.

title: Normal force calculation
description: Important: Correctly identifies the normal force as equal to the weight (mg = 300 N) for horizontal surface.

title: Units in final answers
description: Optional: Includes correct units (N for forces, dimensionless for coefficient) with numerical answers.

title: Confusing static/kinetic friction
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly uses static friction formula or coefficient for the moving sofa in part (3).

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Treats friction as having incorrect sign relative to applied force or misinterprets force balance directions.
